voice.summary: Lakeside Collective talks like a neighbourly studio that knows each member by name and favourite biscuit. It is casual, inclusive and light on job-title ceremony.
dos: Introduce people by what they like doing
donts: Do not call anyone a 'guru' or 'wizard'
Do not use corporate org-chart language

taglines: Say hello to the people of Lakeside
Meet the people behind the work
A team you can actually contact
boilerplate: Lakeside Collective is a twelve-person creative collective covering design, engineering, support and operations, with an open directory of its people.
